evidence.title: GitHub - remix-run/react-router: Declarative routing for React · GitHub

name: React Router
summary: Multi-strategy router for React: use it as a full framework or as a library in your own architecture.
description: Routing for React in two modes: a full framework with server rendering and bundling, or a minimal library you compose with your own architecture. The repo ships react-router, create-react-router and packages for dev, node, express, architect, cloudflare and fs-routes; the docs cover getting started for both framework and library setups, and upgrading from v7.
contains: packages: react-router, create-react-router, dev, node and serve adapters
docs: getting started (framework and library), upgrade from v7, changelog
